classification.difficultyReason: Read outputs and corresponding inputs directly from supplied linear, quadratic and reciprocal graphs.

spec.description: Unit square grid and labelled integer ticks from −7 to 7, excluding zero; arrowed axes and line.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph is permanent; numerical responses appear only in answer editions.

answer.worked: Read across from $y=-5$ to the graph, then down to the $x$-axis: $x=-4$.
Read across from $y=-1.5$ to the graph, then to the $x$-axis: $x=3$.

spec.description: Unit square grid, integer ticks excluding zero, arrowed axes, reciprocal branches with continuation arrows and blue dashed vertical asymptote x=0.

answer.worked: There is no point on the curve with $x=0$; the dashed line is an asymptote. Therefore $f(0)$ is undefined.
